By continuing, you confirm that you have read and agree to the

Accounts
Campfire never reads, stores or uploads any login credentials.

Game data
Game data travels directly between players when possible. It only passes through a relay node when relays are allowed and a direct connection fails, and nodes cannot read it. Node operators can see your IP address and when you connect.

Statistics
Usage statistics are off by default and are only sent after you agree. They never include your IP address, account or rooms.

Scope
Campfire is an independent community project that provides multiplayer rooms, a public lobby and related tools for Minecraft Java Edition. It is not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft or the authors of any launcher.

Rooms of other players
Rooms in the public lobby are listed by other players. Joining the room of a stranger is the same as joining any unknown Minecraft server.

Responsibility
Follow the Minecraft End User License Agreement and the laws that apply to you. You use Campfire at your own risk.

Campfire is a free, open-source project. Anonymous usage statistics show which features are used most and which systems still need support, which decides what gets improved next.

They contain the app and system versions, the processor architecture, the interface language, feature usage counts, a rough region and a random ID, and are sent at most once a day. Your IP address, game account, player names and room details are not collected.
